The benchmark uses filtered_descendants to traverse every matching instance placement.

measurement_notes: One warmup and three measured fresh processes for each of four executables, alternating order, default CPU affinity, no overlapping builds or profiles.
Before and array builds use the stage visitor; the final build uses filtered_descendants. Counts and sorted path/status records verify the same placed-prim domain.
Workload totals sum open, metadata, and array phases. Process times include setup and teardown and are retained separately.

Typed Vec extraction copies shared arrays; sdf::Array extraction shares storage, and mutation detaches it.
The array-only series is an independent earlier comparison. Its percentage is not added to the final series percentage.
C++ deprecation warnings are omitted from retained output. Raw tool output remains in the /tmp reports.
Dependency auditing uses a cached advisory database, not a newly downloaded database.
The array-control and final timing ranges overlap; all three measured pairs improve against the array control.
